artworks.title: Gunpowder Plot
artworks.description: The image shows ten men standing closely together from the waist up. They face each other and appear to be engaged in a discussion. Each man wears a wide-brimmed hat with various decorations. Their facial features include beards or mustaches, and their hair is styled in long, wavy patterns. The men wear period attire reminiscent of Elizabethan or Jacobean styles. The scene likely takes place indoors, as no distinct background is visible. The men's hands are visible, with some gesturing or resting. The text below the image is in Latin and may provide context or identification for the men.

artworks.title: Thomas Percy and the Gunpowder Plot
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of Thomas Percy, a 17th-century historical figure. Percy is shown in an elaborate portrait format, facing slightly left. He has a mustache and beard, with wavy shoulder-length hair under a feathered hat. He wears a high-collared garment with lace detailing. German texts flank him, likely explaining his life or deeds. Below, two smaller circular illustrations show armed men in period military attire. The background is intricately patterned with lines and text.

artworks.title: Gunpowder Plot
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a public execution scene in a historical town setting. The image features an execution platform in the center where a chaotic scene unfolds. The atmosphere is tense, with multiple figures on a raised stage engaged in dynamic movement. Surrounding the central action, the town's architecture consists of tall, pitched-roof houses. A large gathering of onlookers is present, with people on horseback and standing in clusters. In the foreground, some figures appear to have fallen or are lying on the ground. The drawing showcases period costumes, intricate architectural stylings, and careful depictions of figures.

artworks.title: Thomas Percy
artworks.artist: Attributed to Crispijn de Passe I
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man depicted from the shoulders up, positioned in profile. His head is turned to the side, revealing his facial features which include a prominent nose, a beard, and a mustache. He wears a large, broad-brimmed hat with a decorative band around it. His hair is medium length and curls slightly at the ends, visible beneath the hat. The man is clad in a period costume featuring a doublet with a ruffled collar adorned with intricate lace. The background consists of a highly decorative frame displaying various scenes: "Domus Parlamenti" on the top left, "Palatium Regis" on the right, and other historical or significant events illustrated in roundels at the bottom. The text around the portrait provides historical context related to the figure portrayed, and there is a wooden keg or barrel motif beneath the portrait in the frame's design.

artworks.title: Duke of Alva
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a man. Only the upper part of his body is visible, focusing on his head and shoulders. The man is positioned in profile, facing slightly to the viewer's right. He has a long beard and mustache, with a forehead mostly covered by his fringe and short, receding hair. His facial features are sharp and defined, with deep-set eyes and a high forehead. He is wearing armor with ornate detailing on the shoulder area and an elaborately decorated collar. A chain with a medal or pendant is around his neck. The background is filled with closely spaced lines for contrast and texture. Text below the image provides historical information about the figure depicted.

artworks.title: William Ames
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, facing forward with his right hand on his chest and his left hand holding a small book. He has a high forehead, arched eyebrows, prominent cheekbones, a mustache, and a goatee. His hair is closely cropped and he wears a cap. He is dressed formally in a dark robe with a buttoned front and a large ruff collar around his neck. The background consists of closely spaced horizontal lines, providing a textured backdrop to the engraved portrait.

artworks.title: Francis Bacon
artworks.description: The image displays a man seated in an ornate chair. He is facing slightly to the right, with his body positioned side-on to a desk. His right arm rests on the table, holding a feather quill poised to write on an open book. The man's facial expression is calm, featuring a mustache and neatly trimmed beard. He wears a tall, structured hat with ruffled edges. His curly hair is visible under the hat, framing his face. He is adorned in elaborate attire, including a richly embroidered cloak with patterned designs, a large ruffled collar encircling his neck, and a hanging medallion. The chair is decorated with carved patterns and tassels. Above him are illuminated words and a laurel. To the right are two shelves displaying books and a coat of arms. An inkwell is placed on the desk next to the open book. The background features detailed curtains and Latin text at the bottom.

artworks.title: Francis Bacon
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing a seated man depicted from the waist up. He is positioned at an angle, with his body turned slightly towards a writing desk where he is holding a quill pen poised above a large piece of paper inscribed with text. His facial features show a solemn expression with a neatly trimmed mustache and a pointed beard. He is wearing a tall, flat-topped hat adorned with a band and an elaborate ruff around his neck, and his hair is curly and extends to his shoulders. His clothing is richly decorated, with a patterned, fur-lined cloak draped around his shoulders and a starry motif on the sleeves of his tunic. A medallion hangs from his neck. The background reveals a curtain on the left and a shelf on the right holding several books. There is a coat of arms mounted on the wall next to the shelf. The engraving features an ornate cartouche above the man with Latin text, and another block of text occupies the space below the figure.

artworks.title: Richard Carpenter
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man in a traditional 17th-century outfit, holding a book close to his chest. Beside him is a smaller scene depicting a figure kneeling before a seated pope, with Latin writings. The man has a long face, prominent eyes, a small mustache, and mid-length hair. The background has a dark, cross-hatched texture with a light beam shining towards him. Below the portrait are English text lines from the Psalms, dated 1641.

artworks.title: Charles I
artworks.description: The image features an engraving of a kneeling man in profile, facing left. The man is kneeling on a step, pointing with his right hand towards an open book with text, while resting his left hand on his chest. He has a beard, long hair, and wears elaborate clothing. The background shows a wall with two windows, a table with the book, a floral arrangement labeled "Gratia," and a scroll labeled "Christi Tracto." Through the windows, a landscape with a mountain and trees is visible, and there are clouds with beams of light towards the man's heart labeled with Latin inscriptions. In the bottom right corner, there is a crown labeled "Splendidiam et Gloriam". The scene is divided by a column, and the lighting accentuates the man's contemplative posture.

artworks.title: Charles I
artworks.description: The image shows a male figure seated in a contemplative pose. He is leaning forward with his hand resting on a globe and the other holding a compass. The man has long, curly hair, a mustache, and a goatee. He is wearing a hat with a feather, a dark doublet with embroidery, puffed sleeves, and a white ruffled collar. He has a decorative collar or sash with a medallion hanging from his neck. He is seated on an ornate chair. Behind him, there are two angelic figures holding up a banner with the inscription "FIDEI DEFENSOR" surrounded by sun rays and drapery. Latin text is featured on banners around the scene. The room is richly decorated.

artworks.title: Henry, Duke of Gloucester
artworks.description: The image shows a baby seated on a cushioned chair, wearing ornate clothing and holding a small flower. The background features architectural elements, natural scenery, and decorative frames with text and crests.

artworks.title: Henry, Duke of Gloucester
artworks.description: The image depicts a young child seated on an ornate chair. The child has a round face with wide eyes and a small mouth, wearing a bonnet and a full-length gown with ruffles and floral decoration. The gown features puffed sleeves. The child holds a small flower. Surrounding elements include a detailed chair pattern, medallions with inscriptions, cherubic figures holding draped fabric, and a background with trees, deer, swans, and water. Various inscriptions and ornaments are present in the image.

artworks.title: John Donne
artworks.description: This is an engraved portrait showing a person from the waist up. The individual has wavy, shoulder-length hair, parted near the center, with a few curls framing the face, and has a pointed mustache and small goatee. They are wearing a dark, high-collared jacket with visible stitching and a crisp, white collar peeking out from beneath. The individual's left hand is holding a round object close to the chest, and there is an earring in the left ear. The background includes engravings of text, a crest or coat of arms, and decorative borders.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Drake
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up, positioned angled with his body facing left and head turned to look towards the viewer. He has a rounded face with a prominent forehead, arched eyebrows, a medium-length mustache, and a evenly trimmed beard. His hair appears curly and above his ears. The man is wearing an elaborate outfit with a high, lace-trimmed collar, metal buttons or studs, and a sash crossed over his chest. He is holding a compass in his left hand against a sea chart on a surface. The background has a textured, crosshatched pattern. Text at the bottom identifies him as "Sr Francis Drake."

artworks.title: Robert Devereux, Third Earl of Essex
artworks.description: The image is an engraving depicting an upper-body view of a man holding back a curtain to reveal himself. The man is facing forward and slightly to the side, looking directly at the viewer with a slight smile. He has long, wavy hair, a mustache, and is dressed in a 17th-century military outfit with armor and a lace collar. He is holding a baton or staff in his left hand. The surroundings include an inscription in an oval frame and a coat of arms with a crown above it to the upper left. The background features an oval frame with text underneath the image, presenting a poetic verse about the subject. The paper shows signs of aging with minor brown spots.

artworks.title: Sir Thomas Fairfax, General of the Forces Raised by Parliament
artworks.description: The image depicts a man on horseback, facing forward in a commanding pose. He has a pointed mustache and a goatee, shoulder-length curly hair, and wears elaborate armor with a cape. He holds a long baton. Army encampments with tents and troops surround the horse. Above to the left, there is a decorative oval with inscriptions. The backdrop shows rolling clouds in the sky, adding to the dramatic scene.

artworks.title: Leticia Morison, Viscountess Falkland
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraved portrait of a woman. She is facing forward but slightly turned to her left. She has large, wide eyes, a somber expression, and her hair is mostly covered by a dark headdress. She wears a modest neckline garment, holds a closed fan or object in her right hand close to her chest. The setting includes an elaborate border with leaf-like patterns. Below the portrait, there are ornate decorations, such as a skull, an "In Domino Quies" inscription on a cartouche, cherub-like figures holding drapery, and a scene showing a ship at sea. The background features delicate lines and shading typical of historical engravings.

artworks.title: Daniel Featly, age 65
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated from the waist up. He has a mustache, beard, high forehead, and short, neatly combed back hair. He is dressed in formal or religious attire with a high collar and a dark coat, holding a small, rectangular book. A ring is visible on one of his fingers. The portrait is framed in an oval with detailed inscriptions, lions in the top corners, and a Latin inscription at the bottom. In the background, outside the oval frame, there is an illustration of a hand holding a candle on the right and an open book or manuscript on the left.

artworks.title: Daniel Featly, age 65
artworks.description: The image depicts a man with a narrow face, a mustache, and a small beard, sitting and looking directly at the viewer. He is wearing dark, formal attire with a ruffled collar. One of his hands holds a small book and he is wearing a ring on one finger. The background shows an ornate oval frame with various decorative elements.

artworks.title: Edmund Gregory
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait engraving of a man from the waist up. He is facing slightly to the left, with one hand on his chest. The man has an elongated face, arched eyebrows, a slight mustache, and chin-length wavy hair. He wears a formal period garment with a wide collar, buttons down the front, and a circular pendant around his neck. The background features trees, a path, and a drawn-back curtain. The border includes inscriptions in Latin, and a poetic verse is below the portrait.

artworks.title: Joseph Hall, Bishop of Norwich
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of Reverend Joseph Hall from the waist up. He is seated, slightly turned to his left, writing in a book with a quill pen. He has a prominent brow, deep-set eyes, a mustache, full beard, short dark hair, and wears a cap. He is dressed in a formal garment with intricate embroidery and a large ruffled collar. A medallion or pendant with an embossed design is visible around his neck. In the background are bookshelves filled with books and a shield displaying a heraldic emblem. Above him is a banner with a Latin inscription.

artworks.title: Joseph Hall, Bishop of Norwich
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a man seated and slightly turned to the right, looking directly at the viewer. He has an elongated face with a mustache and beard, short hair covered by a cap, and is wearing elaborate early 17th-century clothing with a ruff collar, a detailed cloak or robe, and a large medallion on a chain around his neck. He holds a quill pen over an open book in his right hand. The background features shelves of books, suggesting a library setting, and an emblem or coat of arms to the right. Latin inscription is above the image, and stylized English text is below, providing context.

artworks.title: James, First Duke of Hamilton, as Marquis
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man, depicted from the chest up, facing slightly to the viewer's right. He is positioned upright, looking directly at the viewer. The man's hair is medium-length, curly, and reaches just above his shoulders. His facial features are prominent with a serious expression. He is wearing a richly detailed garment with a large lace collar and a patterned fabric. Additionally, a broad sash is draped diagonally across his shoulders. Around the portrait is an oval frame with inscriptions in Latin text. The background is textured with fine lines. Beneath the portrait, there is an ornate text description and a table listing regiments and their officers.
